categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Modifies the functional test framework (P2PInterface) to wake `wait_until` loops immediately upon message receipt, carrying the Tests label.
categories.rationale: Directly improves test framework execution speed by removing avoidable polling delays, achieving a verified 11–17% runtime reduction across the functional test suite. Reviewers confirmed substantial drops in individual test durations (e.g., wallet_conflicts from 44s to 9s), providing durable, recurring time savings for CI and local development.
